# Underwriting Memo: Fairhallow Kitchen Co

**Risk summary**

Fairhallow Kitchen Co operates family restaurants with on-site kitchens and catering services in Orlando, FL. The account presents a total insured value of $3,390,000 under governing class REST (Restaurant). The insured operates at an inland location (79.9 km from coast) with an emerging broker, Calvetti Insurance. Fit score is 74.5.

**Appetite and referral**

This risk is **IN** appetite per **AG-001** (Restaurant full service is a target class, write up to $12M TIV) and **AG-014** (Southeast inland locations acceptable). The account falls well within TIV limits and meets territorial guidelines. No referral triggers identified.

**Loss history**

Five-year loss history shows 6 claims totaling $174,300 incurred. Activity includes 2 claims in 2021 ($88,700 incurred, largest: customer injury), 3 claims in 2024 ($58,500 incurred, largest: slip and fall), and 1 claim in 2025 ($27,100 incurred: theft). Loss-free years in 2022-2023. Frequency and severity are moderate for restaurant operations.

**Exposure and concentration**

Single location in Orlando with $60.13M portfolio TIV within 25km radius. Non-coastal positioning mitigates catastrophe exposure.

**Recommendation**

Suggest proceeding with quote. Request additional details on slip-and-fall prevention measures and theft controls given recent claim activity.
